# Face to face

Face to face is for typing to someone opposite you while you keep a secure grip on your phone.

The keyboard faces you. The text you type faces away from you, upside down from your side, so the other person can read along as you type. They don't have to wait for you to finish, or wonder what's going on.

## Using it

1. On the home screen, tap **Face to face**.
2. Hold your phone so the top half faces the other person. It starts with: "Hello. I'm deaf, so I'm typing to you. Read along here."
3. Type your message. They see it as you type.

## When they want to reply

Tap **Continue side by side** and pass them the phone. See [Side by side](side-by-side.md).

To finish, tap **End face to face**.
